body:
Building off of https://github.com/CliMA/ClimaCoupler.jl/pull/2180, this PR adds the `DOWNSTREAM_CI` which skip tests. 

In addition, the environment variable `NEW_T_END` is added to allow users to adjust the simulation ending time of the nightly runs. This is needed for https://github.com/CliMA/ClimaCore.jl/issues/2666. The goal is to run very short `ClimaCoupler` nightly run as part of ClimaCore CI.
title: Skipped tests for downstream testing and setting t_end for nightly runs
